title: fix(memory): accept batches with omitted zero index

files.patch:
@@ -351,11 +351,14 @@ def embed_batch(self, texts: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
                 raise ValueError("Embedding batch response count does not match input count")
             # Some gateways answer out of order; `index` is the request position.
             if any("index" in item for item in items):
-                indices = [item.get("index") for item in items]
+                # Some gateways omit the default index of zero. The exact
+                # coverage check rejects multiple omissions or an explicit zero
+                # alongside an omission.
+                indices = [item.get("index", 0) for item in items]
                 if (any(type(index) is not int for index in indices)
                         or set(indices) != set(range(len(chunk)))):
                     raise ValueError("Embedding batch indexes must cover every input exactly once")
-                items = sorted(items, key=lambda item: item["index"])
+                items = sorted(items, key=lambda item: item.get("index", 0))
             out.extend(self._post_process(item["embedding"]) for item in items)
         return out

+GEMINI_BASE = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("model, api_base", [
+    ("gemini-embedding-2", GEMINI_BASE),
+    ("gemini-embedding-001", GEMINI_BASE),
+    ("gemini-embedding-2", "https://example.com/v1"),
+])
+def test_gemini_batch_accepts_omitted_zero_index(model, api_base):
+    provider = ScriptedProvider(
+        [{"data": [{"embedding": [0.1, 0.2]}, {"index": 1, "embedding": [0.3, 0.4]}]}],
+        model=model, api_base=api_base,
+    )
+    assert provider.embed_batch(["a", "b"]) == [[0.1, 0.2], [0.3, 0.4]]
+
+
+def test_batch_reorders_items_with_omitted_zero_index():
+    data = [
+        {"index": 2, "embedding": [2.0]},
+        {"embedding": [0.0]},
+        {"index": 1, "embedding": [1.0]},
+    ]
+    provider = ScriptedProvider([{"data": data}])
+    assert provider.embed_batch(["a", "b", "c"]) == [[0.0], [1.0], [2.0]]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("item_indices", [

+def test_invalid_partial_indexes_are_rejected(item_indices):
